confirmedFindings.finding: Adaptive completion required CREATE_REVIEW_PACKAGE even when the current plan did not declare it.
confirmedFindings.fix: Review package is required only when a CREATE_REVIEW_PACKAGE operation is explicitly present in the plan; a declared but missing package remains blocked by missing-operation checks.

confirmedFindings.finding: Two explicit EXECUTE_AUTONOMOUS_SEARCH routing branches could schedule RUN_RESEARCH again after a successful result, before shared continuation/verification planning.
confirmedFindings.fix: Both initial-entry branches now require no successful RUN_RESEARCH result; existing results fall through to the common continuation/verification planner.
confirmedFindings.test: Static branch contract in verify_core_autonomy_regressions_p291.mjs; runtime planner E2E not run because local JSZip dependency is absent.

confirmedFindings.finding: Completion gates treated any historical ERROR as unresolved even after a later successful retry.
confirmedFindings.fix: Added unresolvedTaskErrors. Append-only ERROR history remains intact; recovery is accepted only when a later successful result has the same operation instance or explicitly supersedes its ID. Retry supersession includes an operationScopeKey derived from target/command/operation/query/gap/intent to avoid forgiving a different research query. Errors without operationInstanceId remain fail-closed.

confirmedFindings.finding: Finalization marked a task COMPLETED and recorded success before applying P216 validation; it wrote conversationResponseFinalized while the completion gate looked for conversationFinalResponse.
confirmedFindings.fix: Pass P216 validation into CORE finalization, write conversationFinalResponse only for validated output, and mark COMPLETED/SUCCESS only when both P216 and the CORE completion gate pass. Validation failure becomes FAILED; a valid answer with incomplete task requirements remains PAUSED/WAITING.
confirmedFindings.test: Structural contracts in verify_core_autonomy_regressions_p291.mjs; end-to-end conversation flow not run.

confirmedFindings.finding: Corrupt JSON caused the in-memory task map to be cleared; a later normal save could overwrite the only stored copy. Non-array snapshots and malformed records could also be silently ignored.
confirmedFindings.fix: Invalid snapshots/records are rejected into the same quarantine path. Exact raw bytes are written to a quarantine key and read back before writes resume; if preservation fails, writes are blocked for the process.
confirmedFindings.test: verify_blackboard_corrupt_snapshot_p291.mjs: 4 checks pass using in-memory storage fallback.
